<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">9:41</text>
    <line x1="324" y1="18" x2="324" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="15" x2="329" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="12" x2="334" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="9" x2="339" y2="27" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="20" r="3" fill="#0F172A"/>
    <path d="M347 17 Q353 11 359 17" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <path d="M350 14 Q353 11 356 14" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="367" y="13" width="19" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="15" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="#0F172A"/>
    <rect x="386" y="17" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#0F172A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,69 25,78 34,87" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="78" x2="48" y2="78" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17px" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">QR Scan</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="108" x2="370" y2="108" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Success illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="295" r="104" fill="#DCF0F9" opacity="0.65"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="295" r="78" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="295" r="59" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <polyline points="164,295 184,315 226,270" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="116" cy="239" r="6" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <circle cx="274" cy="344" r="5" fill="#86CCE9"/>
    <circle cx="287" cy="257" r="3" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <line x1="127" y1="329" x2="140" y2="329" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="133.5" y1="322.5" x2="133.5" y2="335.5" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="253" y1="226" x2="267" y2="226" stroke="#52B6DF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="260" y1="219" x2="260" y2="233" stroke="#52B6DF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirmation content -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="438" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20px" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">QR code scanned</text>
    <text x="195" y="469" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Your vehicle has been successfully</text>
    <text x="195" y="494" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">connected to your CarCare account.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="126" y="526" width="138" height="34" rx="17" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
      <circle cx="146" cy="543" r="5" fill="#52B6DF"/>
      <polyline points="143,543 145,545 149,540" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="158" y="548" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#316D86">Scan complete</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">You can now access your vehicle details</text>
    <text x="195" y="622" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">and care features in the app.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Close button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="668" width="326" height="56" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="703" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17px" font-weight="600" fill="#316D86">Close</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="796" x2="370" y2="796" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="42,813 50,806 58,813" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="45" y="812" width="10" height="9" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="50" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Home</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <!-- Vehicles -->
    <rect x="119" y="809" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="809" x2="126" y2="805" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="809" x2="134" y2="805" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="124" cy="822" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <circle cx="136" cy="822" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <text x="130" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Vehicles</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <!-- Scan active -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="814" r="15" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
    <rect x="187" y="806" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="190" y1="810" x2="194" y2="810" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="196" y1="810" x2="200" y2="810" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="190" y1="818" x2="194" y2="818" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="196" y1="818" x2="200" y2="818" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="600" fill="#316D86">Scan</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <!-- Services -->
    <circle cx="271" cy="811" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="811" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <line x1="271" y1="803" x2="271" y2="806" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="271" y1="816" x2="271" y2="819" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="263" y1="811" x2="266" y2="811" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="276" y1="811" x2="279" y2="811" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="271" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Services</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="340" cy="808" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="340" cy="819" rx="8" ry="4.5" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="340" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
